scenarioSurface.capabilityName: Extract a canonical graph from a validated Scenario Semantic Carrier

input.text: attributable validator-receipt, carrier-binding, graph-canonicalization, or blackout findings

outcome.text: EXTRACTION_HELD is returned with ordered attributable findings

scenarioSurface.notes: One validated Scenario Semantic Carrier becomes one canonical graph and exact extraction receipt before carrier blackout, or one attributable held disposition.

capability.name: Extract Semantic Carrier Graph
capability.rootExperience: One validated Scenario Semantic Carrier becomes one canonical graph and exact extraction receipt before carrier blackout, or one attributable held disposition.

feature.name: Extract a canonical graph from one validated semantic carrier

shape.description: Exact carrier bytes and their exact conformant validator receipt, including source, validator capability, capsule, grammar, and receipt identities.
One success or held graph-extraction classification with exact validator and carrier lineage and without downstream projection.

On success, one canonical graph, graph digest, validator receipt digest, extraction receipt digest, admitted authority, and established carrier blackout; on failure, ordered attributable findings and no graph completion claim. Carrier bytes are absent in both variants.

input.name: Validated Semantic Carrier Request
input.gherkin: exact unchanged carrier bytes and their exact conformant validator PASS receipt

event.name: Extract Canonical Carrier Graph
event.responsibility: Verify validator lineage, map only declared semantic identities and relationships, normalize ordering, canonicalize and digest one graph, then establish carrier blackout.
event.gherkin: one canonical graph is extracted from the validated bytes and carrier blackout is established

outcome.name: Carrier Graph Extraction Classified
outcome.experience: The caller receives either one canonical graph with exact receipt lineage or ordered attributable held findings; downstream carrier access is closed.
outcome.gherkin: graph extraction is classified without projecting or evaluating downstream meaning

input.name: Extracted Graph Stage
input.gherkin: one canonical graph and exact extraction lineage with blackout established

event.name: Return Extracted Graph
event.responsibility: Return only the canonical graph and exact extraction receipt lineage.
event.gherkin: the extracted graph receipt is returned

outcome.name: Canonical Carrier Graph Extracted
outcome.experience: The caller receives one canonical graph and exact extraction receipt with no carrier bytes.
outcome.gherkin: EXTRACTED is returned with carrier blackout established

input.name: Held Extraction Stage
input.gherkin: attributable validator-receipt, carrier-binding, graph-canonicalization, or blackout findings

event.name: Return Extraction Held
event.responsibility: Return ordered attributable findings without a graph completion claim.

outcome.name: Semantic Carrier Extraction Held
outcome.experience: The caller receives exact held evidence and no graph completion claim.
outcome.gherkin: EXTRACTION_HELD is returned with ordered attributable findings

feature.name: Construct a greeting from one name input

shape.description: One admitted non-empty person name of at most 100 Unicode characters.
One deterministic message formatted as Hello, {name}! from the exact admitted name.

event.name: Greet By Name
event.responsibility: Construct exactly Hello, {name}! from the admitted name without invoking an external effect.

outcome.name: Personal Greeting
outcome.experience: The caller receives a deterministic greeting constructed from the exact admitted name.
outcome.gherkin: the exact greeting Hello, {name}! is returned without an external effect

management.featureDescription: A caller supplies one admitted name and receives one deterministic personalized greeting without an external effect.

userStory.intent: request a personalized greeting by supplying one admitted name
userStory.outcome: receive a deterministic greeting constructed from that exact name

experience.promise: every admitted execution constructs exactly Hello, {name}! from the admitted name without external effects

realizations.effectEvidence: Input contract admission rejects absent and empty names before execution.
The admitted format expression reads the exact name path once.
Two identical inputs must produce byte-identical JSON outcomes.
The carrier declares zero effects and zero provider boundaries; the projected plan must bind only the pure transformation port.

providerQualification: Bindings are declared suppliers, not proof of live availability. Simulation requires explicit fixture/provider evidence.
